research: Slate line Virginia -31.5 equals homeSpreadClose -31.5; the archive's open was -26.5 (possibly a placeholder; OddsTrader said books had not posted a line as of the morning of Nov. 2 and guessed ~20) (slate file; oddstrader.com, 2026-11-02). Helps neither side: close treated as fair.
Total 141.5 -> 142.5: a slow game; laying 31.5 needs roughly an 87-55 final, about 22% of the total (slate file). Slightly helps Drexel.
[angle] Drexel ranked 322nd in pace last season and Virginia 298th; OddsTrader's writer suggested Drexel slowing the game could keep it inside the number (oddstrader.com, 2026-11-02). Helps Drexel.
Drexel lost Shane Blakeney (14.2 ppg, its only double-digit scorer) to South Carolina; top returner Josh Reed averaged 7.9 ppg (oddstrader.com, 2026-11-02). Helps Virginia.
Drexel was 305th in offensive rating last season (68.1 ppg) but 69th in defensive rating (oddstrader.com, 2026-11-02). Offense helps Virginia, defense helps Drexel.
[angle] Drexel's last game vs a high-major in the preview, an 80-50 loss at Syracuse, came on 19-of-59 shooting (oddstrader.com, 2026-11-02). Helps Virginia.
Virginia went 30-6 in Ryan Odom's first season, 16-1 at home, 26th in offensive rating and 59th in defensive rating, with the roster largely intact (oddstrader.com, 2026-11-02). Helps Virginia.
[angle] Thijs De Ridder (15.6 ppg as a freshman) returns and scored 17 in an exhibition win over Villanova (oddstrader.com, 2026-11-02). Helps Virginia.
ATS last season: Drexel 18-13-1 (9-7-1 as an underdog, 6-7-1 on the road); Virginia 17-17-2, 8-8-1 as a home favorite, 6-7-2 non-conference (oddstrader.com, 2026-11-02). Slightly Drexel, but priced.
Virginia's games went under 11 of 17 as a home favorite last season (6-11 O/U) (oddstrader.com, 2026-11-02). A slow home favorite makes a 30+ margin harder: slight Drexel.
Virginia entered ranked No. 9 with title odds around +3000 (oddstrader.com, 2026-11-02). Neutral.
No notable injuries reported for either team (oddstrader.com, 2026-11-02).
games.reasoning: A slow-paced 142.5 total makes a 31.5-point cover a tall ask, but Drexel lost its only real scorer and Virginia returns a 30-win core, so I project roughly a 29-point win: inside 2.5 points of the number and below the bar. The pace angle is the only reason for the forced Drexel side; a hot Virginia shooting night would erase it.

research: Slate line Arkansas -40.5; homeSpreadClose -42.5 (open -40.5); total 161.5 -> 167.5 (slate file). Close treated as fair; slate-vs-close not used.
Predictem's same-day preview listed Arkansas -38.5 / 163.5 at most books (predictem.com, 2026-11-03): the market climbed 2-4 points toward Arkansas through the day. Information, not a fade signal.
Predictem writer's Torvik-based model projected Arkansas by about 33 (94-60) and about 157 points (predictem.com, 2026-11-03). Helps Pine Bluff, but public ratings are priced: tiebreaker only.

[angle] Arkansas returns only one rotation player (Billy Richmond III) and added ten newcomers, eight of them freshmen; RotoWire called it the youngest power-conference team in the country (predictem.com, 2026-11-03). A brand-new roster in game one adds variance; slight Pine Bluff.
[angle] Arkansas shot 32-of-57 (56.1%) at the line across two exhibitions and Calipari criticized it after the Memphis game (predictem.com, 2026-11-03). Helps Pine Bluff against a 40-point number.

Arkansas has size: five players 6-11 or taller, including Furman transfer Cooper Bowser (SoCon blocks leader two years ago) (predictem.com, 2026-11-03). Helps Arkansas against an undersized SWAC team.

Nine Arkansas players averaged 17+ minutes in the exhibitions, and it scored 93 vs Memphis (predictem.com, 2026-11-03). Deep rotation means no drop-off when starters sit: helps Arkansas keep extending.
Georgia transfer Jeremiah Wilkinson made 79 threes last season (predictem.com, 2026-11-03). Helps Arkansas.

Arkansas-Pine Bluff ranks 362nd in Torvik's preseason adjusted offense and 354th overall in KenPom; it went 13-19 and was picked 11th of 12 in the SWAC (predictem.com, 2026-11-03). Helps Arkansas: can the dog score at all?
[angle] Pine Bluff played no public exhibition, so this is its first outside competition (predictem.com, 2026-11-03). Helps Arkansas.
Both teams project fast (about 72-74 possessions) (predictem.com, 2026-11-03). More possessions favor the big favorite's margin: helps Arkansas.
No injuries were reported for either team (predictem.com, 2026-11-03).
games.reasoning: Torvik-type ratings put this near Arkansas by 33 while the market went to 40-42, but ratings are priced and Pine Bluff may not reach 60 points. Shading my number most of the way to the market gives about 37.5, inside the bar: pass. The forced side is Pine Bluff on Arkansas's brand-new roster and poor exhibition free-throw shooting against a 40-plus number; a hot Arkansas shooting night from three would beat it.

research: Slate line Alabama -26.5; homeSpreadClose -27.5 (open -26.5); total 169.5 -> 172.5 (slate file). Close treated as fair.
Predictem's same-day preview listed Alabama -26.5 / 171.5 (predictem.com, 2026-11-03). The line held or rose despite the absences below.

[angle] Aden Holloway (16.8 ppg, 43.8% from three last season) is serving a five-game suspension that covers this game; he returns Nov. 9 (predictem.com, 2026-11-03). Helps Sam Houston, though it was known before the line opened, so likely priced.
[angle] Freshman guard Anderson Diaz (elbow) has not played; Nate Oats doubted he would be ready (predictem.com, 2026-11-03). Helps Sam Houston, likely priced.

Alabama lost Labaron Philon, Latrell Wrightsell and Aiden Sherrell from its Sweet 16 team; it added transfers Drew Fielder and Brandon Garrison for rebounding (predictem.com, 2026-11-03). Slight Sam Houston.
Alabama beat Auburn only 87-85 in an exhibition, and Oats said 'Rebounding still isn't fixed' (predictem.com, 2026-11-03). Slight Sam Houston.

Amari Allen (11.4 ppg, 6.9 rpg as a freshman) is a preseason SEC All-American; freshman Qayden Samuels averaged 16.3 ppg in exhibitions; NC State transfer Cole Cloer hit 8 of 18 threes (predictem.com, 2026-11-03). Helps Alabama.
Torvik projects Alabama at 76+ possessions, the fastest host in Predictem's batch (predictem.com, 2026-11-03). Pace lets a favorite run up a margin: helps Alabama.
Sam Houston went 22-12, finished second in Conference USA and made the NIT, but must replace five double-digit scorers (predictem.com, 2026-11-03). Mixed.

Point guard Justin Begg (9.5 ppg before an ankle injury) and Jacobe Coleman (45 threes as a freshman) made preseason All-CUSA (predictem.com, 2026-11-03). Helps Sam Houston: it has scorers to keep pace.

Torvik has Sam Houston 157th preseason; the writer's pace-adjusted projection was Alabama by about 19 (92-72) and his pick was Sam Houston +26.5 (predictem.com, 2026-11-03). Ratings and preview picks are priced: tiebreaker only, Sam Houston.
games.reasoning: Ratings put Alabama around 19-20, the market at 26.5-27.5 even with Holloway suspended; shading toward the market I get about 24, a 2.5-point gap that misses the bar. The forced side is Sam Houston because Alabama is short its best returning guard and still has rebounding problems; Alabama's 76-possession pace is what could blow it open.
